name: LLM inference (LiteLLM)
description: LLM inference through a LiteLLM proxy, priced per model by the proxy. The site agent mints a key per resource, blocks keys when a resource pauses, and reports tokens and spend from LiteLLM's spend table. token_cost is LiteLLM's own per-model spend in USD, billed at 1.0; the token counts are volume meters priced at 0. The proxy's master key is not asked for: it stays in the agent configuration file on the agent host. Key aliases derive from the resource UUID, so the plugin never claims a key on a shared proxy that Waldur did not mint. Members get LiteLLM users under their portal username. Customers set day, week and month spending limits on token_cost; the order form starts new resources at the default monthly limit, and the proxy refuses a key at its limit. Waldur records usage to the cent.

parameters.label: LiteLLM proxy URL
parameters.description: Base URL of the LiteLLM proxy, e.g. https://litellm.example.com.

parameters.label: Default monthly spending limit (USD)
parameters.description: The monthly spending limit the order form starts new resources with; the customer can change it. At the limit the resource is paused and the proxy refuses its keys. An order through the API sets its own spending_limits. Leave empty to start resources without a cap.
